files.freesoundName: Desert ambiance with slight wind on bushes, muffled gust of wind, road hum, explosion at 4'50
files.description:
Desert ambiance with slight wind on bushes, muffled gust of wind, road hum, plane passing far away, explosion at 4'50 and slight chiming clock. Recorded near Todos Santos

Sound recorded by a MS setup Schoeps Microphone CCM41 & CCM8
Sound Devices 552 Mixer + Sound Devices 744T Recorder
